\texttt{revenue\_\allowbreak{}growth} & next period's revenue growth rate & \texttt{REVENUE; the CF\_WC-bound stocks; CF\_DA, CF\_SBC, CF\_CAPEX, CF\_SBC\_TAX\_WITHHOLD} & revenue rows scale by $1+g$; working-capital stocks bound on the firm's own cash flow move to base $\times(1+g)$; the activity-linked flows scale with it \\
\texttt{cogs\_\allowbreak{}ratio\_\allowbreak{}shift} & additive shift to cogs/revenue ratio & \texttt{COGS; the INVENTORY and AP targets} & cost rows scale by $(1+g)(1+\text{shift})$, and the inventory and payables working-capital targets move with the same factor \\
\texttt{opex\_\allowbreak{}growth} & growth of the semi-variable operating-expense families & \texttt{OPEX\_RND, OPEX\_SELLING, OPEX\_ADMIN} & the semi-variable expense families scale by $1+g_{\text{opex}}$; other operating expense holds at base \\
\texttt{restructuring\_\allowbreak{}factor} & scale on restructuring charges & \texttt{RESTRUCTURING} & restructuring rows scale by the factor \\
\texttt{asset\_\allowbreak{}yield\_\allowbreak{}shift} & additive shift to yield on cash + securities & \texttt{INTEREST\_INCOME (OTHER\_INCOME when no separate lines)} & interest income reprices as (base yield $+$ shift) on the firm's own cash and securities balances; without separate interest lines the net rate effect lands on other income \\
\texttt{debt\_\allowbreak{}rate\_\allowbreak{}shift} & additive shift to the average debt rate & \texttt{INTEREST\_EXPENSE (OTHER\_INCOME when no separate lines)} & interest expense reprices as (base rate $+$ shift) on the firm's own debt and commercial paper balances \\
\texttt{tax\_\allowbreak{}rate\_\allowbreak{}shift} & additive shift to the effective tax rate (zero in the MVP map) & \texttt{TAX; the CF tax articulation rows} & the effective rate, clipped to 5\% to 45\%, applies to projected pretax income through the firm's own calculation arcs \\
\texttt{dividend\_\allowbreak{}growth} & growth of dividends paid, capped and floored by the map & \texttt{CF\_DIVIDENDS; the RETAINED\_EARNINGS leg} & dividends paid scale by $1+d$ and post against retained earnings \\
\texttt{buyback\_\allowbreak{}factor} & scale on repurchases and the share-count trend & \texttt{CF\_BUYBACK; the TREASURY or RETAINED\_EARNINGS leg; SHARE\_COUNT and EPS} & repurchases scale by the factor, post into treasury or against retained earnings, and scale the share-count trend that per-share figures recompute from \\
